	ante_ranking_panel = {
		context_type = player_context
		window_name = "ante_ranking_window"
		visible = { always = yes }

		effects = {
			ante_rank_header_click = {
				if = { limit = { has_country_flag = ANTE_rank_open } clr_country_flag = ANTE_rank_open }
				else = { set_country_flag = ANTE_rank_open }
			}
			ante_rank_close_click = {
				clr_country_flag = ANTE_rank_open
			}
		}

		triggers = {
			ante_rank_body_visible = { has_country_flag = ANTE_rank_open }
		}

		dynamic_lists = {
			ante_rank_grid = {
				array = global.ante_ranking
				change_scope = yes
				entry_container = "ante_rank_entry"
			}
		}

		properties = {
			ante_rank_flag = {
				image = "[This.GetFlag]"
			}
		}

		ai_enabled = { always = no }
	}
